character: Main resort centre of Tignes. Around the frozen lake. Most shops, restaurants, nightlife. 4 cinema screens, casino, ice diving in the lake. Ski-in/ski-out throughout. Lively, high-altitude, snow-sure. Boiler-maker apres.
dining: Wide selection — Savoyard, pizza, creperie, French. Piste-side and village restaurants.
shopping: Supermarket, bakery, sports shops, fashion, pharmacy, post office, banks.
apres_scene: Le Loft, The Saloon, Les Caveaux (nightclub). Lively resort centre. Live music.
activities_nearby: Ice diving in frozen lake (Tignes is world-famous for this). 4-screen cinema. Casino. Ice rink. Indoor pool. Bowling. Paragliding. Snowpark. Espace Killy (300km). Grande Motte glacier (year-round).
